description: List individual KSI indicator entries (like KSI-IAM-AAM, KSI-CNA-CIC) with optional filters for id, text search, category, and status. To see full KSI theme data, use get_frmr_document with path `FRMR.documentation.json#KSI`. Supports pagination via limit and offset. [Category: KSI]

category.description: Filter by KSI theme category (e.g. IAM, CNA, MLA)

id.description: Filter by KSI item ID (e.g. KSI-IAM-AAM)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

status.description: Filter by KSI status (e.g. active, retired)

text.description: Free-text search within KSI titles and descriptions

name: list_ksi
title: List Key Security Indicators
